claims.text: When a team of agents can build in every direction and every item on the list is possible, where do you focus?
claims.quote: When the agents can go in every direction, where do you focus?

claims.text: The rule the owner has used since being a CISO has a name given years ago: places of highest leverage.
claims.quote: the one I have used since I was a CISO, and it has a name I gave it years ago

claims.text: Places of highest leverage: of everything that could be done, work only on the few things that are not blocked and would change a lot, for the people who use the thing and for everything built after.
claims.quote: A few are not blocked and would change a lot, for the people who use the thing and for everything built after. Work on those, and only those, until they stop being that.

claims.text: It is a rule about where, not what: it does not say what the product is, it says where to stand today.
claims.quote: It is a rule about where, not what.

claims.text: You can start without knowing how the whole problem will be solved, because every step produces better tooling, understanding and view; the first step's job is to produce the second step's information.
claims.quote: the first step's job is not to be right. It is to produce the second step's information

claims.text: The mathematical version is the family of methods that begin with a guess, measure and narrow: Fermi estimates, Bayesian updating and Monte Carlo ranges.
claims.quote: Fermi estimates that start wide and get calibrated; Bayesian updating, where each observation moves the prior; Monte Carlo runs that turn a guess into a range

claims.text: Constraints, token budgets, hours, attention and one person's focus, are the reason the rule works rather than the price of it.
claims.quote: I think the constraints are the reason it works rather than the price of it

claims.text: Dan Ward's FIRE model says it in four words, fast, inexpensive, restrained, elegant, and Knowing when to stop is this site's version: value rises fast and then flattens.
claims.quote: The FIRE model from Dan Ward says it in four words, fast, inexpensive, restrained, elegant

claims.text: Saying no is the sharp end of the rule; with agents, Steve Jobs's line about saying no to a hundred good ideas is not a slogan but most of the work.
claims.quote: With agents that is not a slogan. It is most of the work.

claims.text: On 10 October the meter came at 12:09, pay by depth at 13:40, personas at 14:23, encrypted sharing at 15:28 and usefulness setting the price at 15:49, each the place of highest leverage once the one before existed.
claims.quote: Each one was the place of highest leverage once the one before it existed.

claims.text: On 11 October a reading list in a link shipped at 14:30, 81 minutes after its brief, because sending someone to the newsroom as nobody was that morning's friction.
claims.quote: 81 minutes after its brief

claims.text: The first passkey design had a door vault between the passkey and the master; a review in the afternoon took it out as a layer too many, and the owner agreed.
claims.quote: A review in the afternoon took it out as a layer too many

claims.text: At 00:15 on 12 October the lab found the same passkey returns different bytes through a phone over QR than through the provider on the device, so the door went back, as a door per path.
claims.quote: The door went back, as a door per path.

claims.text: At 01:33 real vaults from the browser shipped through the vendored library rather than a writer of our own, and at 02:22 the vault pane went live.
claims.quote: At 02:22 the vault pane, live.

claims.text: Automating the wire's daily run, more beats, scheduling and consumption analytics are parked, because they are valuable only with many readers, which the site does not have.
claims.quote: The second group is parked, and the figure says why in blue: valuable only with many readers.

claims.text: The place of highest leverage is the feedback loop on what exists: the inbox, the marks and the modes, because they make every article better and make the owner a better briefer of the agents.
claims.quote: The place of highest leverage is the feedback loop on what exists

claims.text: Walking back is what a two-way door looks like from inside, in Bezos's distinction between decisions you can reverse and decisions you cannot; removing the door and putting it back were both two-way doors.
claims.quote: Walking back is what a two-way door looks like from inside.

claims.text: The path with two reversals reached a better design faster than getting it right on paper would have, because the paper could not have known what the phone would return.
claims.quote: because the paper could not have known what the phone would return

claims.text: Parking is the same move at the level of a branch: the parked branch stays on the map with its reason, and the reason has a date on it, when there are many readers.
claims.quote: The parked branch stays on the map, with the reason, and the reason has a date on it

claims.text: Forwards there were five choices at each step, with a paywall, a subscription, an account, a recommender, analytics, a server and Google sign-in passed over; the path only looks obvious backwards.
claims.quote: a paywall, a subscription, an account, a recommender, analytics, a server, Google sign-in

claims.text: On the Wardley map the passkey work went from genesis through custom-built to a product in a day, because almost everything under it is a commodity someone else matured.
claims.quote: The passkey work went from genesis, a design on a page, through custom-built, a lab you could press, to a product, a pane on every page, in a day.

claims.text: Synced passkeys with PRF in iCloud Keychain, the WebAuthn PRF extension, Web Crypto with HKDF and PBKDF2, the vendored vault library, the vault server and the Stripe payment link are all products or commodities matured before we arrived.
claims.quote: all products or commodities, all someone else's work, all matured before we arrived

claims.text: Google Password Manager's passkey reached through a phone over QR returns different bytes from the same passkey on the device; that is where a provider is not yet mature, where a custom layer was needed and the work slowed.
claims.quote: That is a place where a provider is not yet mature, and it is exactly where we had to add a custom layer

claims.text: Every piece of work has to be used straight away by someone, and it is fine if the someone is the owner; a step only designed tells you nothing because you have not felt it.
claims.quote: Every piece of work, these days, has to be used straight away, by someone, and it is fine if the someone is me.

claims.text: The briefs come after the shipping: the art of the possible is not reasoned to, it is what shipping leaves behind, and the next brief is made of it.
claims.quote: The art of the possible is not something you reason your way to. It is what shipping leaves behind, and the next brief is made of it.

claims.text: Three days is a sample: the sequence and times are real, but it is one project at one speed, chosen because it is the one the owner can show.
claims.quote: Three days is a sample.

claims.text: The rule does not pick the product: it says where to stand, not what to build; the what comes from using the thing and from the people who ask for it.
claims.quote: Places of highest leverage says where to stand, not what to build

claims.text: The mathematics is named carefully: Fermi, Bayesian and Monte Carlo are the family meant; the memo could not name them, and the analogy is the owner's, not a theorem.
claims.quote: the memo could not name them, and the analogy is mine, not a theorem

claims.text: Parking has a cost: a branch left for later can be overtaken, and the wire's scheduling may need rebuilding when its day comes; that is accepted as cheaper than building for readers who are not there.
claims.quote: A branch left for later can be overtaken; the wire's scheduling may need to be rebuilt when its day comes.
